title: The Entertainer (opening)
short: Scott Joplin · C 2/4 · listen, then play it.
trouble: Reading notes one at a time instead of in chunks.

blocks.html: Ragtime sets a steady, march-like left hand against a right hand that lands just off the beat. The left hand jumps: a low bass note on the beat, then a chord in the middle of the keyboard. Practice the left hand alone until the jumps feel easy. Joplin wrote “Not fast” at the top.
What to notice: The Entertainer, a ragtime two-step (1902): introduction and first strain

blocks.name: music-player
blocks.cap: Play it: the score scrolls, the keys light up, and “wait for me” lets you practise one hand at a time.

items: left-hand jumps: bass note, then chord

blocks.html: Play through it once with the right hand only, then add the left. Which chord change made you stop?

sources.name: Mutopia Project edition (Chris Sawer, from a reproduction of the original 1902 edition; public domain), compared with this file note by note by our checking script, except the last bar, where we leave out the three notes that lead into the next strain.
